ExplorerTabs.cpp adapts the COM class factory, IObjectWithSite lifetime, and
IServiceProvider -> IShellBrowser -> IShellView -> IFolderView access pattern.
The tab model, serialization, frame integration and rendering are new code.
ShellTabs source was not used.
